description: Check wallet balance, USDC balance, quota state, and whether the next /fetch call will succeed without payment. Use before spending — tells the agent exactly how much to fund.

address.description: The Ethereum wallet address to query (0x...).

name: nanoparse_status

outputSchema.description: Machine-readable status fields. This schema describes structuredContent — strict MCP clients validate structuredContent against it, so it must NOT require the result-envelope `content` array.

estimated_parses_remaining.description: null when the balance is unknown — never 0, which would imply an empty wallet

next_call_will_succeed.description: null when the free tier is exhausted and the balance is unknown

usdc_balance_raw.description: Balance in micro-USDC; null when the chain could not be read
